chunks: "The ghusl (ritual bath) for the two Eids is a sunnah (recommended practice)."

key_terms.الْعِيدَيْنِ: the two Eids, Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha
key_terms.سُنَّةٌ: a recommended prophetic practice, not obligatory

ai.seo_question: Is ghusl for Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha obligatory or recommended?
ai.summary: This hadith states that performing ghusl (ritual bath) for the two Eids is a sunnah, meaning a recommended religious practice. It indicates the desirability of preparing for the Eid prayer and occasion with ritual purity.
